title: Ines and the Cipher
author: Freya Voss
blurb: Petra Marchetti, an estate lawyer reading a will that shouldn't exist, prides themselves on never taking a case they can't close. Then a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the trial begins.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
